name: Два списка
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one extremely simple, polished website Languages section for Globoox, landscape 1536×864. Flat forest-green #2C3B2D background, warm ivory #F4F0E8 text, muted light sage secondary text. Lora-like Cyrillic serif headline, Inter-like supporting text. Realistic compact website spacing, generous side margins, no huge empty lower half. ONLY typography and, when specified, a single subtle hairline. No illustrations, books, cards, badges, pills, flags, icons, ornamental lines, gradients, textures, shadows, buttons, controls, header or footer. Avoid decorative cleverness. This is a quiet supporting section, not a spectacular hero. Required exact copy, each item ONCE: heading “Языки перевода”; current label “Уже доступны” with English, Français, Español, Русский; upcoming label “Скоро” with Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Türkçe, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, العربية, فارسی. Keep all four available names and all nine upcoming names clearly grouped and readable; correct accents/scripts. Available names medium-large, upcoming smaller but readable. Do not add any text or numbering. Heading upper left. Under it two text columns side by side: current group on the left with four vertically stacked medium serif names; upcoming group on the right as a 3 by 3 smaller sans-serif grid. Both group labels align on one baseline. No lines or decoration.
